text: The Climate Relocation of Communities (CROC) Program and Trust Fund (CROCTF) in Fiji is the world's first national initiative to integrate a comprehensive government relocation framework with a dedicated financing mechanism. Established in 2019, it aims to address the displacement of communities due to climate change impacts such as sea-level rise, erosion, and saltwater intrusion. The program is designed to safeguard lives, livelihoods, and cultural continuity by facilitating community relocations through a structured policy and financial support system.
